say:3:1410541001:1.text: I've never seen any creatures like them before—so furry, and they can talk!
say:3:1410541001:1.source_cn: 这、这是什么？毛茸茸的，还会说话！

say:4:1410541002:1.text: We are <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s hamster familiars! Chippy is a knight, and Hammie is a mage!
say:4:1410541002:1.male: We are <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s hamster familiars! Chippy is a knight, and Hammie is a mage!
say:4:1410541002:1.female: We are <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s hamster familiars! Chippy is a knight, and Hammie is a mage!

say:5:1410541003:1.source_cn: 仓鼠使魔是什么？或者说仓鼠是什么？

say:6:1410541004:1.text: Hmm... You've seen fluffy hamsters with cheeks all stuffed with food, right?
say:6:1410541004:1.source_cn: ……你没见过仓鼠吗？就是像我们这样，毛茸茸的，脸颊里能...

choice_prompt:7:1410541004.text: Hmm... You've seen fluffy hamsters with cheeks all stuffed with food, right?
choice_prompt:7:1410541004.source_cn: ……你没见过仓鼠吗？就是像我们这样，毛茸茸的，脸颊里能藏很多食物的！

say:8:1410541005:1.text: I see! Hi, Feli! You're only meeting us now because we were sent to find General Hogan!
say:8:1410541005:1.source_cn: 原来如此。斐利尔，你好呀！我们之前被主人派出探查霍根将...
say:8:1410541005:1.male: I see! Hi, Feli! You're only meeting us now because we were sent to find General Hogan!
say:8:1410541005:1.female: I see! Hi, Feli! You're only meeting us now because we were sent to find General Hogan!

say:9:1410541006:1.text: I'm so glad to see you all safe and sound!
say:9:1410541006:1.source_cn: 现在看到各位平安归来，真是太好了！

say:12:1410541007:1.text: Thank you for your hard work, Hammie and Chippy.

say:13:1410541008:0.text: Uh, umm... could I invite you to play? I've never played with hamster familiars before!
say:13:1410541008:0.source_cn: ——那个，我可以邀请你们去玩吗？我还没有跟仓鼠使魔一起玩过！

say:14:1410541009:1.text: Absolutely! Chippy will show you all the wonders of the surface world! Hammie will join too!
say:14:1410541009:1.source_cn: 当然可以！满满带你见识一下地表上的世界！漫漫也一起！

choice:7:0:1.text: This is Feli, an Essail priest.
choice:7:0:1.male: This is Feli, an Essail priest.
choice:7:0:1.female: This is Feli, an Essail priest.
